FailureNoLog: Could not save a diagnostic log. Technical details: {0}
FailureWrongProduct: The selected installation belongs to another product. Select this product's installation directory.
FailureWrongPlatform: The package platform or architecture does not match this system or the installed product. Use a matching package.
FailureDowngrade: A newer version is already installed. Use the same or a newer installer.
FailureRepairMismatch: Repair requires the exact installer package originally used. Locate that package and retry.
FailureDestinationConflict: The destination overlaps another location or contains conflicting files. Choose an empty directory, or move conflicting user files before retrying.
FailureBusy: Another installer is using this installation. Wait for it to finish and retry.
FailurePermission: Access was denied. Choose a writable directory and check your folder permissions.
FailureMissing: A required file or directory is missing. Check the installation path and package, then retry.
FailurePackage: The package or installation record is invalid. Obtain an intact package, or check the existing installation record.
FailureFileInUse: A file is in use. Close VeroScript and applications using its files, then retry.
FailureDiskFull: There is not enough disk space. Free space on the installation and temporary drives, then retry.
FailureIO: A file operation failed. Check permissions, available disk space and whether files are in use, then retry.
FailureInput: An input value or path is invalid. Check the selected folder and installation options.
FailureUnknown: The operation could not be completed. Check the diagnostic details before retrying.
